name: Touki Reijou Asuka Saishuushou - Owarinaki Oyako Shujuu Kaizou Sanran Jigoku
original_name: 闘姫隷嬢アスカ最終章　終わりなき母娘主従改造産卵地獄
source: Asuka managed to hold out and keep her mind intact as she faces Girudea’s ministrations, but he has a new plan in mind to break her spirit once and for all. Tentacles, futa, egg-laying, and boundless expressions of pleasure await in this hot conclusion to Asuka’s final defeat!
